pages.title: A crown after death
pages.text: “A crown does not always mean power over the living. Sometimes it only proves its owner survived the impossible.”$(br2)The Crown of the Beyond is the headpiece of a special Ghost armor set.

pages.title: A name in the soul
pages.text: When the Crown is equipped and $(l:abilities/spirit_sense)Spirit Sense$(/l) is active, you can see the name engraved in a creature’s soul and its condition.
